review.cisco-ai.faq.q1: Do I need DNA Center for Cisco AI Analytics?
review.cisco-ai.faq.a1: Yes, Cisco AI Network Analytics runs as part of DNA Center (now Catalyst Center). You need to deploy the DNA Center appliance on-premise to use these features.
review.cisco-ai.faq.q2: Does it work with non-Cisco devices?
review.cisco-ai.faq.a2: Limited. While DNA Center can discover and monitor some third-party devices, the AI analytics features work best with Cisco Catalyst and Meraki hardware. For multi-vendor environments, consider alternatives like Datadog or Splunk.
review.cisco-ai.faq.q3: What's the difference from Meraki AI?
review.cisco-ai.faq.a3: Meraki has its own cloud-based AI features. DNA Center/Catalyst Center provides similar capabilities for on-premise Catalyst equipment. The two can integrate through the DNA-Meraki integration for unified visibility.
review.cisco-ai.faq.a4: Initial DNA Center deployment typically takes 2-4 weeks for a large enterprise. Getting full value from AI analytics requires historical data collection, so expect 1-3 months before predictive features are fully trained.
